note: First real end-to-end run on genuine CH2 x LRO pixel data (not synthetic). Result is weak (4 inliers) and rung 1 (mod-pi) found zero matches on this same pair. Diagnosed cause: LRO NAC corners are SPICE-derived via a nadir-pointing approximation (io_lro.py docstring: errors <0.5 deg near poles), not measured geometry. align_pair trusts these corners exactly when building the common grid, so a real position error there can leave the two aligned arrays showing the same general terrain without being pixel-registered. Phase-correlation coarse pre-alignment was attempted as a fix (3 window sizes) and did not find a consistent offset (response 0.01-0.03, shift estimates disagreed by hundreds of pixels across window choices) -- ruled out a simple global translation as the explanation. Root cause not fully resolved; documented as a known limitation rather than presented as a validated accurate registration.
